title: Critical subgraphs and the regularity of symbolic powers of cover ideals of graphs
summary: Let $G$ be a simple graph. We demonstrate a method for using $t$-admissible subgraphs of $G$ to determine the regularity of the $t$-th symbolic power of the cover ideal of $G$. As an application, we compute the regularity of powers of cover ideals of bipartite unicyclic graphs.
